name: python3-speechd
x-comment: Speech Dispatcher's Python client alone (the daemon is the host's, reached through xdg-run/speech-dispatcher).
build-commands: site=$(python3 -c 'import sysconfig; print(sysconfig.get_path("purelib", vars={"base": "'${FLATPAK_DEST}'"}))') && install -Dm644 -t "$site/speechd" src/api/python/speechd/__init__.py src/api/python/speechd/client.py && printf 'SPD_SPAWN_CMD = "/usr/bin/speech-dispatcher"\n' > "$site/speechd/paths.py"
